user.title: Add an HP printer
user.description: Enter the printer's address. Give it a name to control what its entities are called — leave it blank to use the model name.

data_description.host: Prefer the printer's mDNS name, such as NPI2E7F3D.local, which survives address changes. An IP address works too.
data_description.name: Used for the device and all of its entity IDs. Short names work best.

data_description.port: The embedded web server port. Leave at 80 and it will follow to 443 automatically if you turn on HTTPS.
data_description.ssl: Printers use a self-signed certificate, which is not verified.
data_description.password: Optional and currently unused: CDP writes are served with no credential, and an LEDM model has no maintenance interface. Kept for a firmware that starts requiring one; it is held in memory and never sent.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure printer
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant reaches this printer. It must still be the same physical device.

data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the current password.

zeroconf_confirm.title: HP printer found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {model} at {host}. Give it a name to control what its entities are called, or leave it blank to use the model name.

data_description.name: Used for the device and all of its entity IDs. Short names work best.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer. Check the address, and that the printer is powered on.
error.not_ledm: That host answered, but it does not look like an HP printer with a supported embedded web server.

abort.already_configured: This printer is already set up.
abort.serial_mismatch: That address belongs to a different printer than the one this entry was created for.
abort.cannot_connect: Found a printer, but could not read from it. It may be asleep, or it may not support the management interface this integration uses.
abort.reconfigure_to_resolve: This integration reads the printer without credentials. Update the host address from the integration's settings to continue.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to read the printer. Printers sleep between jobs and polling wakes them, so slower is gentler on the device.

serial_mismatch.message: {device} reported a different serial number than expected. The address may now belong to another printer.

maintenance_failed.message: The printer refused the maintenance request: {error}

maintenance_already_running.message: A maintenance operation is already running on this printer.

maintenance_unavailable.message: This printer does not offer that operation.

calibration_unavailable.message: This printer does not offer that printhead alignment.

calibration_no_paper.message: Printhead alignment needs paper. The input tray reports empty, so nothing would be printed to align against.

calibration_state.name: Printhead alignment in progress
calibration_state.description: Where an alignment currently is, in the printer's own words. An alignment is a two-party job: the printer prints a pattern and then waits for it on the scanner glass, so a value like ScanRequested means it is waiting for you.

genuine_mono_pages.name: Black and white pages on genuine supplies

setup_state.name: Setup state
setup_state.description: First-time setup progress. A step still pending here is why a calibration reports as failed.

active_alert_count.name: Active alerts
active_alert_count.description: Alerts the printer is raising right now. The event log is history; this is the present.

active_alert_worst.name: Most severe active alert
active_alert_worst.description: Severity of the most urgent active alert, in the device's own order.

firmware_update_result.name: Last firmware update
firmware_update_result.description: Whether the last firmware update succeeded. The build date does not say.

certificate_expires.name: Web certificate expires
certificate_expires.description: The self-signed certificate expires ten years after issue, with nothing to warn first.

adapter_errors.name: Network interface errors
adapter_errors.description: Error counters per network interface. The split is what shows which port is live.

internet_diagnostics.name: Internet connectivity
internet_diagnostics.description: The printer's own connectivity test. Its timestamp is unusable without a real-time clock.

cartridge_changes.name: Cartridges used in this slot
cartridge_changes.description: How many cartridges this slot has held. The maximum across slots, since they are refilled independently.

region_reset_remaining.name: Region reset attempts left
region_reset_remaining.description: Attempts left under the device's region-reset scheme before it stops allowing them.

print_jobs.name: Print jobs
print_jobs.description: Jobs the print engine has taken. A job can be counted here and still have failed, so this is not the same as pages printed.

network_printed_pages.name: Pages printed over the network
network_printed_pages.description: Pages that arrived over the wired network. The split against the wireless figure is what shows which path is actually being used.

memory_available.name: Free memory
memory_available.description: Free memory in kibibytes, as the device reports it.

default_orientation.name: Default page orientation
default_orientation.description: The orientation a job gets when the driver says nothing. A setting, not a measurement of what came out.

failed_attempts_remaining.name: Sign-in attempts left
failed_attempts_remaining.description: Failed web-interface sign-in attempts left before it locks. This is why a factory-default admin password is worth changing.

successful_attempts_remaining.name: EWS sign-in attempts remaining
successful_attempts_remaining.description: The other half of the failed-attempt budget the device publishes alongside it. Read the two together.

printhead_non_hp_drops.name: Ink drops printed (not recognised as HP)
printhead_non_hp_drops.description: The printhead's own tally of drops it could not attribute to genuine HP ink. Not the same claim as a cartridge's brand field: a clone chip reports the genuine part number, so a third-party cartridge can present as HP while this counter disagrees. Zero is the reassuring reading.

wifi_encryption.name: Wi-Fi encryption in use
wifi_encryption.description: The cipher the printer's Wi-Fi allows. The device also reports the network's name and its pass phrase in clear text; neither is read by this integration and neither will appear here or in a diagnostics download.

firmware_update_failure_reason.name: Why the last firmware update failed
firmware_update_failure_reason.description: The update status says the attempt failed but not why, and the reason is the diagnosis: 'manifestNotFound' means the printer cannot find any firmware to install, which is a different problem from a failed download.

supply_alert_colors.name: Colours with a live supply alert
supply_alert_colors.description: The alert names a category; the colour is a pointer inside its data rather than prose. Without this an alert is a complaint with no subject.

media_loaded.name: Paper loaded
media_loaded.description: The size and type currently loaded in each tray, from the media document this interface was not reading before.

snmp_public.name: SNMP accepts the public community
snmp_public.description: On means the printer accepts the built-in public community string, so any host on the network can read its management data.

setup_incomplete.name: Setup steps outstanding
setup_incomplete.description: On while a first-time setup step is outstanding.

firmware_update_failed.name: Last firmware update failed
firmware_update_failed.description: On when the most recent firmware update attempt failed.

port_9100_enabled.name: Raw printing on port 9100
port_9100_enabled.description: On means the printer accepts raw printing jobs on port 9100 — no driver, no job structure, no authentication.

https_redirection.name: HTTP redirects to HTTPS
https_redirection.description: Off means the printer's own web interface answers plain HTTP, so the admin password crosses the network in the clear.

duplexer_installed.name: Duplexer fitted
duplexer_installed.description: Whether a duplexer is fitted. Not the same question as automatic duplex, which is a setting and can be off on a machine that has one.

auto_duplex_enabled.name: Automatic duplex
auto_duplex_enabled.description: The auto-duplex setting. A machine with a duplexer can have this off and still have printed thousands of double-sided sheets.

print_quality_report.name: Print print-quality report
print_quality_report.description: Has the printer print its own print-quality diagnostic. Cheaper and more reliable than guessing from a photo of a page.

status_report.name: Print status report
status_report.description: The printer's status report: configuration, firmware, consumables and counters, on paper.

diagnostics_report.name: Print diagnostics report
diagnostics_report.description: The full diagnostic report. This is the one to read when a machine is misbehaving and you want it to tell you why.

privacy_report.name: Print security and privacy report
privacy_report.description: The security and privacy report: what the printer is reachable by and what it stores.

ledm_calibrate_printhead.name: Align printhead (prints a pattern to put on the scanner glass)
